sphere_re100: honest blocked report -- surface-only MEM does NOT rescue it (D=12 +9.15%, D=18 +8.0-8.9%, converged but to a wrong value). Decisive negatives: (1) domain/blockage lever is void -- lateral 16->32 at D=10 gives step1000 = 1.3177 vs 1.3178 (bit-identical 4dp), the sphere near-field force is local; (2) an independent control-volume instrument agrees (D=16 1.1985, D=20 1.2130), so it is NOT a caliber bug but a STAIRCASE-GEOMETRY bias -- the sphere is doubly curved while cylinder_3d is singly curved, and the sphere interior fraction is 0.62-0.71; (3) refining does not reduce it (D=8 +14.5% -> D=12 +9.15% -> D=14 +10.19%). Needs a smooth boundary representation (octree R10 reached +1.59% but at 0.03 steps/s is infeasible) or D>=30 (exceeds 15 GiB/card). STATUS counts unchanged (21 verified / 20 pending). Also notes surface-only MEM is not a blank cheque -- it fixed cylinder_3d because that body is singly curved

cylinder_3d PROMOTED to verified (3rd new case this cycle): Cd +2.45%/-0.19% on two grids (span 2.64%). All-solid over-predicts (+5.3%/+4.0%) while surface-only recovers the correct answer. Also the true cause of the historical sphere MEM +264% failure.
